caption: The drawing features several objects rendered in a realistic style with subdued color tones. At the top center is a large, cylindrical cut section of a tree trunk, with a rough brown textured bark and a lighter, yellowish-brown, flat cut top surface that shows the tree rings and cracks. On top of the stump, there is a metallic tool and a nail placed together, both in shades of gray with metallic highlights. Below to the left, there is a smaller sketched drawing of a hand holding the same tool vertically against a similarly shaped small round cut of wood. Toward the middle right of the drawing, there is a precise illustration of the same metallic tool depicted upright, showing a cylindrical handle and a multi-pronged, comb-like base. To the right of this tool, there is a small, faint sketch showing three toothed impressions, possibly made by the prongs of the tool. The background of the drawing is a light beige or off-white color, and the name "Oscar Bluhme" is written in small printed letters toward the lower right.
title: Plinker and Wood Block
